proposal.summary: Adobe After Effects (<= 22.0 and <= 18.4.2) contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability that can disclose sensitive memory and could be used to bypass mitigations such as ASLR. Exploitation requires user interaction: a victim must open a malicious file.
proposal.affected_product: Adobe After Effects versions 22.0 (and earlier) and 18.4.2 (and earlier)

AV.quote: An attacker could leverage this vulnerability to bypass mitigations such as ASLR.

UI.quote: Exploitation of this issue requires user interaction in that a victim must open a malicious file.

C.quote: out-of-bounds read vulnerability that could lead to disclosure of sensitive memory.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Request or review vendor advisory and available patches; obtain a proof-of-concept or exploit details to confirm impact and refine CVSS metrics (especially AV/PR), and advise users to avoid opening untrusted files until patched.

evidence_quotes.quote: out-of-bounds read vulnerability that could lead to disclosure of sensitive memory.
